FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}« Il neige, il neige, bergère, reste
sous l'édredon ! » {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Qu'est-ce que tu
dis de cette version, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Stamattina non fa che nevicare!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Lo sapevi che Zampet ha dipinto
anche paesaggi innevati?
Io adoooro l'arte,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It sure is chilly this morning.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} But it
makes me feel frisky,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Fa freddino stamattina.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ma non c'è
niente da fare, io adoooro l'aria
fresca,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu sabah epey serin.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ama nedense
içimi kıpır kıpır yapıyor, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
The snow today is like confetti to
celebrate your visit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ooh, la neige ressemble à des petits
confettis...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Parfait ! Exactement ce qu'il fallait
pour célébrer ton passage chez
nous, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
I fiocchi di neve sembrano tanti
coriandoli bianchi lanciati in tuo
onore,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Der Schnee ist heute wie Konfetti
zur Feier deines Besuches,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Bugünkü kar, ziyaretini kutlamak için
yağan konfetiler gibi, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Reste un moment chez nous,
{{TAG:0005:0000:}} ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ne te laisse surtout
pas impressionner par ce froid !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Lass dich von der Kälte nicht
abschrecken!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Bleib doch noch
etwas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You again! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Do you think it'll keep
dumping snow all night,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hé, re-salut toi !
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Dis, tu crois qu'il va neiger comme
ça toute la nuit ? {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh, di nuovo tu! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ho la sensazione
che domani al nostro risveglio ci
sarà taaanta neve,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh, du bist es! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Meinst du, es hört
auch irgendwann mal wieder auf
zu schneien,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yine sen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Sence bu kar gece boyunca
böyle bastırmaya devam eder mi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}I'm so happy to see you again{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's pretty cold out,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so be sure to
bundle up if you're going to spend
much time outside,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Qué alegría verte{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Estoy congelada... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Más vale que
te abrigues si quieres pasar mucho
rato fuera,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Je suis aux anges de te revoir{{TAG:0007:0007:}} !{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu l'as sans doute remarqué, mais il
fait un froid de canard dehors.
Alors ne lésine pas sur les couches
de vêtements si tu vas te balader,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's really late!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Please be careful to
mind the cold better than you've
minded the time,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il est tard.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Tu as perdu la notion du
temps, on dirait.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bon, essaie de ne pas perdre la
notion du temps qu'il fait, au moins,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh, che tardi.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Hai perso la
cognizione del tempo? Non perdere
quella del freddo, eh,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Saat çok geç olmuş!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Zamana dikkat ettiğinden
daha çok soğuğa dikkat et lütfen, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Salut!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Saremo mica
caduti in un freezer?!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Io potrei fare
il ghiacciolo alla fragola, no?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Vay!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dışarısı resmen
dondurucu gibi!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Neyse ki soğuk beni
pek rahatsız etmiyor.

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Ich sollte um diese Zeit eigentlich
gar nicht mehr wach sein.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Aber ich muss doch dem Schnee
beim Fallen zusehen,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
